items.title: Joseph Rene Interview, 1960-04-07
items.q: Yeah, that's Tasso's right. He was the leader of that man. But that was a wonderful drummer, he was the leader.

ctx.x: Yeah, that's Tasso's right. He was the leader of that man. But that was a wonderful drummer, he was the leader. Ace man. And he had timpani, and bells, and chimes, he had everything. And, well I was pretty, a fellow would always, it sounds something, and the bass drum had a beautiful sound. So I'd carry it. Right now, in my grip, I got all my music paper, you know, doing my trance, you know, arranging. I've got, still got a guitar tuner. That's how I catch things, you know. And you know what I used to do…
